name: dronn1k-kit
description: Skills and agents for research, code, notes and change reports in Claude Code.

plugins.name: dk-research
plugins.description: Structured research: the analyze skill settles width and depth and runs analyst subagents in parallel, then merges their findings with confidence levels and sources.

plugins.name: dk-code
plugins.description: Plan-first coding: the engineer agent writes code by bundled coding rules only after the user approves a plan, the architect agent proposes and reviews solutions, the code-flow skill runs the protocol.

plugins.name: dk-notes
plugins.description: The obsidian-docs skill: write or reformat documentation and notes as Markdown in an Obsidian vault or a project's docs folder.

plugins.name: dk-report
plugins.description: The change-report skill: turn a finished code change into a feature-level, non-technical task report.
